name: Use the demo without JavaScript errors
description: Verifies that normal navigation, sample selection, filtering, and export actions do not surface JavaScript errors.
steps: Navigate to the configured PR deployment URL. Run only this test plan: sample selection, filters, CSV/JSON exports and runtime errors. This test does not require any file upload.
Select the L1 sample flight scenario
Select the L2 sample flight scenario
Open the findings filter controls
Reset the filters

Keep valid L2 selected (not L10). Wait until button #download with accessible name "Seçili kaydı CSV indir" is enabled. Start waiting for a download BEFORE clicking that button, then capture the downloaded CSV. This triggers a file download, not page navigation. Verify the downloaded file is nonempty CSV.

Wait until button #report-json with accessible name "Denetim raporunu JSON indir" is enabled. Start waiting for a download BEFORE clicking, then capture the JSON report. Do not wait for page navigation. Parse the downloaded JSON to verify valid report content.

steps.assert: Verify the UI remains usable throughout the interactions
Verify no JavaScript errors occur during the workflow
